purpose: Machine-readable source checks for deterministic research components. Proxies are explicit and are not claims about unobserved market state.

assumptions.rule: Use Binance spot klines as 12-column exchange observations, preserving the published open time, close time, OHLC, volume, trade count, and taker-volume fields.
Interpret spot timestamps before 2025-01-01 as milliseconds and timestamps from 2025-01-01 as microseconds, then store normalized event time as integer UTC microseconds.
Require the published SHA-256 sidecar and ZIP integrity before ingesting an archive; retain raw bytes and provenance.

assumptions.rule: Never use a zero-cost backtest. Because this dataset has no historical bid/ask or queue state, spread, slippage, and impact are conservative OHLCV proxies and must not be presented as observed execution costs.
Do not conflate exchange market-data timestamps with blockchain confirmation state or consensus timestamps; protocol/on-chain signals require separate data and confirmation modeling.
